expectedComments: Explain the AS-facing contract, selected inputs, exact observations, and the important ownership/boundary rule for: Constructs a key from its stable name. @param KeyName Registered key name. Constructs an input chord from a primary key. @param Key Primary key. Constructs an input chord with explicit modifier state. @param Key Primary key. @param bShift Requires Shift. @param bCtrl Requires Control. @param bAlt Requires Alt. @param bCmd Requires Command. Reports whether Caps Lock was active for the event. Marks the reply as requiring unthrottled Slate processing. Requests mouse capture for a widget. @param Widget Widget that receives captured pointer input. Requests high-precision mouse input for a widget. @param Widget Widget that receives raw high-precision movement. Requests release of current mouse capture. Requests that the cursor remain inside a widget. @param Widget Widget whose bounds constrain the cursor.
expectedObservations: Consume every non-void result and compare its exact semantic value. Exercise both true and false outcomes unless the API contract documents a single reachable result.
inputs: Nominal values for every listed parameter, one default or empty state, and one behavior-specific boundary derived from the registration notes.
